# Purpose

Award credit for a correct torque load path, solid-shaft torsion derivation, bolt-group equilibrium, average bolt shear stress, symbolic stress matching, practical integer selection, and bounded engineering recommendation.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes rigid flanges, identical equally spaced bolts, uniform direct shear, static torque, and no frictional transfer from bolt preload. A complete coupling design also requires bolt bearing, fatigue, flange strength and flexure, shaft and hub details, preload, fit, alignment, stress concentrations, and applicable standards.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and idealization: 20%;
- shaft and bolt stress derivations: 30%;
- symbolic bolt-count derivation: 20%;
- integer selection and numerical verification: 20%;
- engineering recommendation and limitations: 10%.
